positions.title: PhD student in Medical Physics and Radiopharmaceutical Sciences
positions.description: Multidisciplinary PhD in Imaging and Radiooncology integrating physical and chemical methods into cancer research. Topics include advanced imaging (CT, MRI, PET, hyperpolarized MRI), precision radiation therapy (IMRT, IGRT, MR-guided, proton/ion beam), imaging data science, and radiopharmaceutical development. Open to physicists, mathematicians, computer scientists, engineers, biologists, pharmacists, and chemists.
